	--Put this inside of your Frame and configure the speed if you would like.
	--Enjoy! Credits go to: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z25nyNBG7Js&t=22s
	
	local UIS = game:GetService('UserInputService')
	local frame = script.Parent
	local dragToggle = nil
	local dragSpeed = 0.25
	local dragStart = nil
	local startPos = nil
	
	local function updateInput(input)
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		local position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
		game:GetService('TweenService'):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(dragSpeed), {Position = position}):Play()
	end
	
	frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then 
			dragToggle = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = frame.Position
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragToggle = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
	
	UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			if dragToggle then
				updateInput(input)
			end
		end
	end)
	
end
coroutine.wrap(ZBJTMR_fake_script)()

    Green = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0), Blue = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255),
    Yellow = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0), Purple = Color3.fromRGB(128, 0, 128),
    Pink = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180), Black = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),

    Brown = Color3.fromRGB(139, 69, 19), DarkBlue = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 139),
    DarkRed = Color3.fromRGB(139, 0, 0), DarkGreen = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 0),
    Silver = Color3.fromRGB(192, 192, 192), LightBlue = Color3.fromRGB(173, 216, 230),
}
local CurrentColor = Colors.Green
local colorList = {} for _,c in pairs(Colors) do table.insert(colorList,c) end

local AdminUserIds = {}

local function GetPlayerRole(p)
    if game.CreatorType == Enum.CreatorType.User then
        if p.UserId == game.CreatorId then return "Ownership" end
    else
        local gid = game.CreatorId
        local ok,inGroup = pcall(function() return p:IsInGroup(gid) end)
        if ok and inGroup then
            local rank = p:GetRankInGroup(gid)
            if rank == 255 then return "Ownership"
            elseif rank >= 200 or AdminUserIds[p.UserId] then return "Administrator"
            else return "Membership" end
        end
    end
    if AdminUserIds[p.UserId] then return "Administrator" end
    return "Guest"
end

closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() frame.Visible=false openBtn.Visible=true end)

local function makeToggle(name,y,def,cb) local b=Instance.new("TextButton") b.Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,0,25) b.Position=UDim2.new(0,10,0,y) b.Text=name..": ON" b.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(50,50,50) b.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1) b.Parent=frame local s=def b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() s=not s b.Text=name..": "..(s and"ON"or"OFF") cb(s) end) end

rainbowBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() RainbowMode=not RainbowMode rainbowBtn.Text="Rainbow: "..(RainbowMode and"ON"or"OFF") if RainbowMode then task.spawn(function() local i=1 while RainbowMode do CurrentColor=colorList[i] i=i%#colorList+1 task.wait(0.1) end end) end end)

scripts.title: simple esp
scripts.script:
--[[
  Grandmother's Clean ESP
  No config, no fuss – just works.
  Press F1 to toggle.
--]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local enabled = true
local objects = {}

local function clear()
    for _, objSet in pairs(objects) do
        for _, obj in pairs(objSet) do
            obj:Remove()
        end
    end
    objects = {}
end

local function update(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then
        if objects[player] then clear() end
        return
    end

    local char = player.Character
    if not char or not char.Parent then
        if objects[player] then
            for _, obj in pairs(objects[player]) do obj:Remove() end
            objects[player] = nil
        end
        return
    end

    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    if not head then return end

    local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToScreenPoint(head.Position)
    if not onScreen then
        if objects[player] then
            for _, obj in pairs(objects[player]) do obj.Visible = false end
        end
        return
    end

    local dist = (Camera.CFrame.Position - head.Position).Magnitude
    local size = math.clamp(150 / dist * 1.5, 20, 100)
    local x, y = pos.X - size / 2, pos.Y - size / 2

    local objs = objects[player]
    if not objs then
        objs = {}
        objs.Box = Drawing.new("Square")
        objs.Box.Thickness = 1
        objs.Box.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        objs.Box.Transparency = 0.7
        objs.Box.Filled = false

        objs.Name = Drawing.new("Text")
        objs.Name.Size = 14
        objs.Name.Center = true
        objs.Name.Outline = true
        objs.Name.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
        objs.Name.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)

        objs.HealthBg = Drawing.new("Square")
        objs.HealthBg.Thickness = 0
        objs.HealthBg.Filled = true
        objs.HealthBg.Color = Color3.fromRGB(50,50,50)
        objs.HealthBg.Transparency = 0.5

        objs.Health = Drawing.new("Square")
        objs.Health.Thickness = 0
        objs.Health.Filled = true
        objs.Health.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0,255,0)
        objs.Health.Transparency = 0.5

        objects[player] = objs
    end

    objs.Box.Position = Vector2.new(x, y)
    objs.Box.Size = Vector2.new(size, size)
    objs.Box.Visible = true

    objs.Name.Text = player.Name
    objs.Name.Position = Vector2.new(pos.X, y - 16)
    objs.Name.Visible = true

    local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    local hp = hum and (hum.Health / hum.MaxHealth) or 1
    local hw, hh = 30, 4
    local hx, hy = pos.X - hw/2, y + size + 2

    objs.HealthBg.Position = Vector2.new(hx, hy)
    objs.HealthBg.Size = Vector2.new(hw, hh)
    objs.HealthBg.Visible = true

    objs.Health.Position = Vector2.new(hx, hy)
    objs.Health.Size = Vector2.new(hw * hp, hh)
    objs.Health.Color = hp > 0.5 and Color3.fromRGB(0,255,0) or (hp > 0.25 and Color3.fromRGB(255,255,0) or Color3.fromRGB(255,0,0))
    objs.Health.Visible = true
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not enabled then clear() return end
    for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do update(p) end
    -- cleanup
    for p in pairs(objects) do
        if not Players:FindFirstChild(p.Name) then
            for _, o in pairs(objects[p]) do o:Remove() end
            objects[p] = nil
        end
    end
end)

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(i, p)
    if p then return end
    if i.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F1 then
        enabled = not enabled
        if not enabled then clear() end
    end
end)

script:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Parent"):Connect(function()
    if not script.Parent then clear() end
end)

print("✅ Clean ESP loaded. Press F1 to toggle.")
